people.text: Alan is keen on history, and wants to visit a castle that was the site of well-known historical events. He'd like the castle to be near the coast, with tours led by a guide.
Yoshiko wants to see a castle that people are still living in. She loves visiting beautiful gardens, and would like to explore interesting places in the castle.

Paulo and Maria collect antiques, so want to visit a castle that still has some of its original furniture on display, and hear about the building's history. They also want something that's particularly suitable for young children.
Kerim wants somewhere with a great historical atmosphere, with typical food from the past to try, and people dressed in costume. He'd also like to see art that's been in the castle for centuries.
Jake and his brother have always wanted to visit the ruins of a castle surrounded by water, with great views. Jake also wants to learn about any wildlife living in and around the castle.

items.label: A
items.title: Durston Castle
items.text: Has a valuable art collection, secret tunnels (one leading to the beach), and visitors mustn't miss the unusual rooms deep beneath the castle walls. Because the building is the Durston family's home, some parts cannot be visited - but you can sit on the grass under the trees and admire the flower beds and fountains. There's a play area for children too.

items.label: B
items.title: Castle Hemsworth
items.text: Guides dressed in historical costumes give visitors information about the traditional castle building, towers and gardens. Wild horses live nearby. Inside, the castle looks unchanged, with old furniture and portraits of people who've lived here.

items.label: C
items.title: Chartsmouth Castle
items.text: Once owned and lived in by kings. Visitors love exploring the rooms, some of which have hidden tunnels. You can see the sea from the top of the walls, and younger visitors will love the outdoor games.

items.label: D
items.title: Rushford
items.text: An old castle on the coast which is a popular local attraction. The Rushford Castle cafe in the walls serves food typical of the castle's history. Inside, there are beautiful rooms with antique tables and chairs. Outside, visitors can see a wide variety of wildlife.

items.label: E
items.title: Castle Woodward
items.text: Experience what life was like at the time it was built. Staff wear clothes typical of the time, and offer everyone tasty snacks made using recipes from different periods of history. Inside, the walls are covered with original paintings of the generations of people who've lived in the castle.

items.label: F
items.title: Marlin
items.text: Only a few parts of the ancient castle are left, but you can still visit some underground rooms and see beautiful countryside from the high tower. The castle is in the middle of a lake and has lovely gardens. There are talks about the castle, and the bats, birds and butterflies that have made Marlin their home.

items.label: G
items.title: Carston Castle
items.text: Experts at the ruins of Carston Castle will show you around and give you information - and offer you 17th-century snacks! Hear how the building was once the scene of famous battles, and is now home to a variety of wildlife. And from the south side, there are fantastic sea views.

items.label: H
items.title: Sawbridge Castle
items.text: Built in 1712 on an island in a lake. Inside, you can still see beautifully designed beds, tables and other objects once used by families living there. Put on headphones and listen to information about the history of Sawbridge Castle. Visitors of all ages will love the toy museum in the gardens.

explanations.6: Alan 喜欢历史，想参观沿海且有导游带领的著名历史事件发生地的城堡。G 城堡 “Carston Castle” 曾是著名战役的发生地，有专家带领参观，从南侧可欣赏到美妙的海景，符合要求。“Experts at the ruins of Carston Castle will show you around... Hear how the building was once the scene of famous battles... from the south side, there are fantastic sea views.” 对应 “near the coast, with tours led by a guide... historical events”。
explanations.7: Yoshiko 想参观仍有人居住的城堡，喜欢参观美丽的花园并探索城堡内有趣的地方。A 城堡 “Durston Castle” 是 Durston 家族的家，有花床、喷泉和供儿童玩耍的区域，游客可以坐在树下的草地上欣赏，符合需求。“Because the building is the Durston family's home... you can sit on the grass under the trees and admire the flower beds and fountains.” 对应 “people are still living in... beautiful gardens... explore interesting places”。
explanations.8: Paulo 和 Maria 收集古董，想参观仍有原始家具展示并了解建筑历史的城堡，还希望适合小孩。H 城堡 “Sawbridge Castle” 里面仍然可以看到曾经被居住在那里的家庭使用的设计精美的床、桌子和其他物品，花园里有玩具博物馆，符合要求。“Inside, you can still see beautifully designed beds, tables and other objects once used by families living there... Visitors of all ages will love the toy museum in the gardens.” 对应 “original furniture on display... history... suitable for young children”。
explanations.9: Kerim 想要有浓厚历史氛围的地方，能尝试过去的典型食物，有人穿着古装，还想看到在城堡里保存了几个世纪的艺术作品。E 城堡 “Castle Woodward” 工作人员穿着当时的服装，提供用不同历史时期的食谱制作的美味小吃，墙上覆盖着居住在城堡里的几代人的原始画作，符合需求。“Staff wear clothes typical of the time, and offer everyone tasty snacks made using recipes from different periods of history... the walls are covered with original paintings of the generations of people who've lived in the castle.” 对应 “historical atmosphere, typical food... people dressed in costume... art that's been in the castle for centuries”。
explanations.10: Jake 和他的兄弟一直想参观被水环绕的城堡废墟，有美丽的景色，Jake 还想了解城堡内外的野生动物。F 城堡 “Marlin” 古老的城堡只剩下几部分，但可以参观一些地下房间，从高塔上欣赏美丽的乡村景色，城堡位于湖中央，有关于蝙蝠、鸟类和蝴蝶的讨论，符合要求。“Only a few parts of the ancient castle are left... The castle is in the middle of a lake... talks about the castle, and the bats, birds and butterflies that have made Marlin their home.” 对应 “ruins of a castle surrounded by water... great views... wildlife”。
